rites.name: Amalor
rites.text: Amalor is a resonant concept of Tarnurock, understood as the pull that binds loose stone into the first roots during the Singing. Its shape is felt rather than seen, a hum that tells the forming land where to hold and where to give way.

rites.name: Elaenuareth
rites.text: Elaenuareth is the sleeping thread of the Weave in Tarnurock, a concept of quiet growing power that the makers planted during the Seeding. It is felt as the slow pull that binds the first groves and their young kingdoms together.

rites.name: Tenkaramoma
rites.text: Tenkaramoma is a concept drawn from the Tarnurock of the Three Futures, an idea that exists only where the ending splits into branches and the Library keeps a shelf for each outcome. It is less a being than a rule about which branch is allowed to be read aloud. Its feats are small and precise, meant to shape a single decision rather than a landscape.
